lastName.description: Family name; needed for Yotpo Reviews.

firstName.description: Given name; needed for Yotpo Reviews.

externalId.description: Merchant customer ID, omitted if unavailable.

customer.description: Customer checkout identity and names; names required for Yotpo Reviews.

placedAt.description: Order placement instant in the store, with explicit offset or Z.

totalPrice.description: Line total in order currency units.

subtotalPrice.description: Line discounted subtotal in order currency units.

customProperties.description: Line-specific review metadata and suppression choice.

suppressReviewRequest.description: Prevent automatic review requests for this line when true.

items.description: A purchased product, quantity, and optional pricing and review metadata.

lineItems.description: Purchased lines; each merchant product ID must be unique and already in Yotpo.

orderName.description: Customer-facing name; provider uses externalId if omitted.

totalPrice.description: Total after discounts including shipping, tax and tips, in shop currency units.

cancelledAt.description: Optional recorded cancellation instant; does not cancel the commerce-platform order.

fulfillments.description: Initial fulfillment records; success plus a date can enable review requests.

externalProductId.description: Merchant product ID on the order.

items.description: A fulfilled product and its quantity.
Products and quantities fulfilled, all belonging to the order.

status.description: Fulfillment state; success enables review-request eligibility.

externalId.description: Merchant fulfillment ID unique within the order.

fulfilledAt.description: Fulfillment instant with explicit offset or Z.

items.description: An initial fulfillment with its products and optional shipment tracking.

paymentStatus.description: Recorded payment state; does not move money.

subtotalPrice.description: Discounted subtotal before shipping, tax and tips, in shop currency units.

countryCode.description: Valid ISO country code; provider default US when omitted.
Valid ISO country code; provider default US when omitted.

customProperties.description: Typed order review metadata; account enablement may be required.

customerCountry.description: ISO country for review metadata; provider default US; needed for non-US Google seller ratings.

id.description: Yotpo ID of the created order.

tags.instructions: Products must already exist in Yotpo; use `list-products` to verify merchant product IDs. At most 500 unique product lines and 100 initial fulfillments. Successful dated fulfillments can trigger automatic review requests; orders older than six months cannot receive them. Metadata may require Yotpo support enablement. Save the returned id.

functions.name: create-order-fulfillment
functions.description: Register one fulfillment on an existing Yotpo order, including fulfilled quantities and optional tracking details.

fulfilledAt.description: Fulfillment instant with explicit offset or Z.

status.description: Fulfillment state; success enables review-request eligibility.

externalProductId.description: Merchant product ID from the order.

items.description: One fulfilled product and its quantity.
Products and quantities fulfilled, all belonging to the order.

FunctionInput_yotpo_createorderfulfillme.description: Register fulfillment facts for one existing Yotpo order.

id.description: Yotpo ID of the created fulfillment.

FunctionOutput_yotpo_createorderfulfillm.description: The created fulfillment ID and its parent order ID.

customProperties.description: Custom product name/value properties.

functions.name: delete-dynamic-coupon-codes
functions.description: Request deletion of all uploaded dynamic coupon codes for one review-request action.

couponAction.description: Review-request email action whose complete uploaded code pool should be deleted, for example map_review.

FunctionInput_yotpo_deletedynamiccouponc.description: Select the review-request action whose entire uploaded dynamic coupon code pool should be deleted.

requested.description: Yotpo accepted the asynchronous deletion request; not confirmation that codes have disappeared.

couponAction.description: Action whose code pool was selected.

FunctionOutput_yotpo_deletedynamiccoupon.description: Acknowledgement of an asynchronous dynamic coupon code pool deletion request.

tags.instructions: This removes the entire code pool for the specified action, not one code. Use `list-dynamic-coupon-codes` first to inspect inventory. Deletion is asynchronous; codes may remain visible briefly. No undo operation is available here; re-import known codes if needed.

functions.name: delete-user-data
functions.description: Request deletion or anonymization of one user's personal data, optionally across all organization stores and with UGC unpublishing.

email.description: Email of the end-user requesting data deletion.

allStores.description: True applies deletion to all stores in the connected organization, including order and review metadata; false targets the connected store.

unpublish.description: True unpublishes the user's UGC while anonymizing personal information; false leaves UGC published as Anonymous.

FunctionInput_yotpo_deleteuserdata.description: One user privacy deletion request with optional organization scope and UGC publication choices.

accepted.description: Provider accepted the asynchronous privacy request, not proof that deletion has finished.

FunctionOutput_yotpo_deleteuserdata.description: Acknowledgment of an asynchronous privacy deletion request, not deletion completion.

tags.instructions: Use for a user's privacy deletion request; `get-user-data-existence` checks current account data first. Anonymized personal data is not recoverable through this tool. By default UGC is unpublished; it can later be manually republished as Anonymous. The response acknowledges an asynchronous request. Use `batch-delete-user-data` for up to 100 emails and leave five minutes between deletion submissions.

functions.name: delete-webhook-filter
functions.description: Delete an unused event filter; referenced filters cannot be removed.

filterId.description: Yotpo ID of unused filter to delete.

FunctionInput_yotpo_deletewebhookfilter.description: Identifies the unused webhook filter to delete.

FunctionOutput_yotpo_deletewebhookfilter.description: Acknowledgment of the selected webhook filter deletion.

tags.instructions: Find IDs with `list-webhook-filters`. Inspect references with `list-webhook-subscriptions` and remove relevant subscriptions using `delete-webhook-subscription` first. This does not cascade. No restore is established.

functions.name: delete-webhook-subscription
functions.description: Remove one subscription's delivery configuration without deleting its target or filter.

FunctionInput_yotpo_deletewebhooksubscri.description: The webhook subscription whose delivery configuration will be removed.

deleted.description: Provider acknowledged deletion, not cancellation of in-flight events.

FunctionOutput_yotpo_deletewebhooksubscr.description: Acknowledgment that Yotpo deleted the selected webhook subscription configuration.

tags.instructions: Find subscriptionId with `list-webhook-subscriptions` and inspect with `get-webhook-subscription` if needed. Deletion cannot retract sent notifications; in-flight delivery cancellation is not guaranteed. No restore is established. Targets and filters are not intentionally removed.

functions.name: delete-webhook-target
functions.description: Delete an unused callback target without removing the external server or cascading through subscriptions.

targetId.description: Yotpo ID of unused target to delete.

FunctionInput_yotpo_deletewebhooktarget.description: Identify the unused webhook target to delete.

FunctionOutput_yotpo_deletewebhooktarget.description: Acknowledgment that the specified webhook target was deleted.

tags.instructions: Get targetId from `list-webhook-targets`. Inspect `list-webhook-subscriptions` and remove references with `delete-webhook-subscription` first. Targets may serve multiple events/accounts. No restore is established.

functions.name: export-email-analytics
functions.description: Request that Yotpo email a CSV analytics export to a specified address. Returns request acceptance, not the export file or a delivery guarantee.

since.description: Inclusive first sent-email date; requires until.

until.description: Inclusive last sent-email date; requires since.

emailType.description: Category filter; omit for all emails.

emailAddress.description: Recipient to whom Yotpo should send the export file.

reminderNumber.description: Reminder ordinal for product_reminder or site_reminder only.

FunctionInput_yotpo_exportemailanalytics.description: Recipient and optional sent-email date range and category filters for an emailed CSV analytics export.

requested.description: Yotpo accepted the export request; does not establish generation or delivery.

FunctionOutput_yotpo_exportemailanalytic.description: Export request acceptance and the requested recipient, not the export file or delivery status.

tags.instructions: Use when the user wants a CSV sent by email. Use `list-email-activity` for immediately usable records or `get-email-analytics-overview` for counts. Confirm the intended recipient through ordinary task context before calling; calling again can request another email. This tool does not wait for export generation or delivery.

functions.name: export-user-data
functions.description: Request an asynchronous user-data export sent to the connected Yotpo account's email address. Returns request acceptance, not the export file.

email.description: Email of the user whose data should be exported; does not select the export recipient.

FunctionInput_yotpo_exportuserdata.description: The user whose data export should be requested.

accepted.description: Yotpo acknowledged the export request; does not establish that data exists, email delivery, or export completion.

FunctionOutput_yotpo_exportuserdata.description: Acknowledgment of the asynchronous export request, not the export file.

tags.instructions: First use `get-user-data-existence` if needed. This sends the export link to the account's email, not to the queried user. The link expires 48 hours after request generation. If no email arrives within 24 hours, contact Yotpo support. Do not wait for the export within this call or repeat requests blindly.
